name: Punitsuma ~Oku-san wa Anatairo~
original_name: ぷにつま ～奥さんはあなた色～
source:
Main character can not satisfy his newly wed wife. But when her sister comes by there's no problem with protagonist in bed. Sister-in-law taught him how to satisfy his wife, but the affair did not stop there...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公无法满足新婚妻子。但妻妹来访后，他在床上便不再有问题。妻妹教他如何满足妻子，但这段关系并未就此停止……
